phases: before original-context plus general plus live
resource_phase_admission.provider_source: Official WCL rateLimitData for the exact configured key, with token/secret never recorded
resource_phase_admission.threshold: At least95 percent of hourly quota available: finite positive limit and finite nonnegative pointsSpent <=0.05*limit. Missing, invalid or unavailable quota data does not admit the phase.
resource_phase_admission.wait: If insufficient, wait only for provider-declared reset/retry time, then query rateLimitData again before admission. Preserve observed_at, limit,spent,reset/retry and admitted decision in private metadata. No speculative polling or inferred quota reset.
resource_phase_admission.does_not_change: Per-run480s Chat/360s WCL/one60s no-tools repair; planned repetitions and frozen criteria; no replacement or adaptive retry. An in-run upstream failure remains a failed trial. Quota admission does not guarantee upstream success.

Current recovery read2026-09-10T01:41:42UTC cloud showsused0percent/spendControlfalse. This does not establish precise earlier failures or retrospectivelypassV12.
resource_phase_admission.joint_requirement: Both official WCL and actual cloud Codex admission must pass before any phase model or Chat creation.

codex.source: Official account/rateLimits/read on actual cloud runtime Codex account; local account status is not substitute. Do not retain account identifiers.
codex.buckets: Check all main codex limit buckets, including codex and codex_bengalfox when returned; prefer rateLimitsByLimitId over legacy rateLimits. Empty/missing relevant bucket data fails closed, never select only most favorable bucket.
codex.windows: Each bucket must contain both primary and secondary keys. Explicitnull means provider declares no such window and is allowed; each bucket must have at least one valid nonnull window. Every nonnull window requires finite nonboolean usedPercent0..5 inclusive, finite nonboolean windowDurationMins>0, and valid finite nonboolean resetsAt Unix timestamp later than observation/admission current time. Missing keys or invalid values fail closed.
codex.spendControlReached: Must be explicitlyFalse. True, missing, null or unknown does not admit.
codex.wait: Insufficient quota: wait only for explicit provider reset and recheck fresh official data; no Chat/model creation before admission, no extended per-run budget, no replacement retry of failed trials.
codex.evidence: Keep sanitized observed_at/bucket/window/reset/spendcontrol decision and SHA, no tokens/accountid/provider secrets.
